horoscopes.horoscope: Today, you will focus your lens on the one you’ve taken a fancy to! You are high on energy, but low on commitment to work. It won’t be surprising if your bosses are miffed. But still, says Ganesha, it’s a day of flowers and love notes. You will seem to have a quick and effective solution to all the problems and will be able to spend quality time with your loved ones. You will turn more responsible in the domestic activities. Your lover will be surprised to see your energy and commitment, feels Ganesha. The stars indicate that you are likely to feel very avid and bouncy today. But, you need to control yourself, and refrain from taking spontaneous decisions. This may also deplete your energy very quickly and cause fatigue says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that you will feel inclined to indulge in speculation today. You will seriously think about investing your surplus funds into the stock market. If past investments have ceased to grow, think of selling them. An action-packed day is waiting for you and you will be super- energetic in everything you do, says Ganesha. You are in a mood to complete all the tasks effectively and are likely to earn appreciation from your superiors and colleagues, foresees Ganesha.

There ain’t no mountain high enough and there ain’t no valley deep. Today, you will find yourself on an invincible run. You might be your own worst enemy today if you waste your effort and energy for unproductive purposes. Overall, it is smooth sailing today and Ganesha advises you to stay focussed. Being with your soulmate will be your topmost priority even though a hectic day is on the cards. You have to take a lot of responsibilities to carry out domestic functions. Taking care of his/her family is likely to be an important task, feels Ganesha. By and large, your health is likely to be good. But, the planetary positions indicate that you may feel less confident. As a result, you might encounter minor hurdles while doing your routine tasks in office and home, says Ganesha. Ganesha predicts that on the financial front, things will just average today. But, you shall not face any monetary tightness, and you will feel rather comfortable on account of your financial situation. Today at work, it will be a race against time as the deadlines loom large. You will not take kindly to any form of interference. A helping hand, however, will be welcome. You will be focused and determined to achieve your deadline or target effectively.

You will be dressed to kill today. People around you may or may not comment, but they will definitely notice you. Your sense of style and taste will bowl everyone over. People would scramble for a glimpse of you. You will be a celebrity. Most probably, your beloved will share the limelight with you. You will tend to apprise your beloved about your work and future plans since you strongly believe in shared values and shared approaches in life. You wish to move steadily with your lover. Your commitment is strong and well appreciated, says Ganesha. There is good news on the health front as you will face no problem there. However, you need to take care of your relationships with others as your arguments with people might waste your time and energy. Stay cool, clear and positive. Today looks pretty normal for money matters. Ganesha advises you to avoid running after more money, as it is going to disappoint you. Just stay put with routine practices, suggests Ganesha. You will be convinced that you are right on a particular issue which is under debate or discussion. Boost your confidence and try to present your point of view as clearly as possible to avoid conflicts. Only assignments, presented accurately, will be recognized, says Ganesha.

You are at your industrious best today. You will be able to think the unthinkable, achieve the unachievable, and impress an emotionally impregnable boss. Your confidence level will be sky-high; in fact, it will make overconfidence wallow in self-doubt. Your colleagues will be awestruck, considering themselves lucky to see you in action. You will spend a good time with your partner. Your love life will be smooth, but Ganesha suggests that don’t try to prevail upon your beloved. Reading novels, listening to music will be some activities which will be entertaining to you, says Ganesha. Your day will be marked by absence of any major health issue but very high level of sensitivity. If you over react, people can really make you feel upset. So avoid being resistant towards things, be flexible and practical, says Ganesha. Ganesha suggests you to invest money in fixed deposit or government schemes today, as they will give you more and stable returns. By and large, the day looks good to Ganesha, from financial point of view. You are well organized and disciplined today. You are able to prioritize the objectives and will efficiently spearhead all the responsibilities given to you. Tasks, eventually completed, will give ultimate satisfaction. Your accountabilities will be highly recognized by the senior authorities.

The thing with skills is that they are not static; they are as dynamic as anything else. It is akin to being on a treadmill — you need to continuously keep moving just to stay in the same place, says Ganesha. So keep refreshing yourself by learning new things in order to sustain your progress. What you need is passion to help you shine in your profession, according to Ganesha. Lucky Colour Light Bright Yellow You will be true blue romantic tonight as you not only want to devote maximum time to your sweetheart but also want to share some crazy intimate moments that will be worthful in any relationship. You will bring some creative aspects in romance that will result in a long-term bond. Today you will be in very good health and humour. This will raise your efficiency level and you could perform very well in profession. Control your anger today and do not give up on anything. You should give strong fight to adversities. Big investments will need to be well planned and must not prove to be impulsive decisions, feels Ganesha. Where as, small things like clothes or any other thing that makes you feel ‘royal’ can be bought today. Today will be the beginning or end of a very important project. You are confident in handling any big projects. You will be very pleased with yourself to have achieved what you have. You may also try to use this as an opportunity to impress your superiors, feels Ganesha.

One scale weighs work and the other weighs personal matters. But you Leos will keep both in check. Revel in stag debauchery and tonnes of merrymaking today. The desire to succeed will be fuelled even more today as you cut yourself loose, says Ganesha. Good news is that you want to spend time with your sweetheart and want to understand him/her. You may have a plan to surprise your partner. Choose a peaceful destination and share whatever you want with your soulmate, feels Ganesha. A blissful night is on the cards, says Ganesha. Health may be a concern for you today. However, you can manage the health issue and irritation. You can do this by not being impulsive and seeing, analyzing the situation before reacting to it. That would make things better for you. Despite your efforts to save money, chances of money getting spent will remain high due to today’s planetary positions. You should not regret over this as this is just a passing phase and is not going to last very long. Today, planets are heavily stacked against any task you take up, even the most insignificant one. So relax and avoid taking up anything significantly important. Your in-depth analytical skill is likely to magnify the practical picture of your department or company, feels Ganesha.

If one were to put an earnest spirit and a frank attitude together, the result would be a Leo; it’s like your hallmark. And with qualities like these in your kitty, don’t be surprised if you happen to reach a milestone or two today. So, is it marital bliss or career success? That may the question to ask; but no matter what, be assured that your societal standing gets a heady boost today, says Ganesha. A good day at work will lead to a great day in your love life. Romance will be back to the top of your priority list and you’ll make your sweetheart feel special. You may be in a mood to tease your lover and sing a romantic song, feels Ganesha. You will have good connection and relations with the people around you today. This will provide you happiness and a sense of satisfaction. Higher levels of enthusiasm is going to help you. Balanced diet will be taken which will keep you in good health. It is a good day to start something side by side, if you are an employee. In short, time is good for building another financial ground to bolster your funds– as fall back arrangement. Today is when you should be arranging that tricky group discussion or meeting as you will be at the best of your game. You may have to handle a greater responsibility. You will have a smooth progress at work and you will eventually be satisfied with your achievement.

A shadow of foreboding grows large in your mind today. Your senses are at the highest alert, feels Ganesha. Keep your eyes and ears open to avoid troubles both at home and work. You will have to put some extra efforts to ensure that love is not lost. Keeping in touch with your lover will pay you off in the long run. You may not get what you want in a relationship immediately. Understanding and patience, both are equally important in a long- term relationship. Today you will enjoy very good health and mood. You will be able to prove your abilities at workplace. People will be accepting your authority which will make you feel good. Your enthusiasm will be very high and you will not be disappointed by problem. This is ideal time for jumping from job to business to earn more money. Alternatively, it is ideal day to switch to a better paying job. By and large, the day is good for decisions that can influence your finances. You want to sustain your career. You are in a search of achievement and status. Therefore, to do well in your career will be the foremost priority today. Towards the end of the day, you will draw a great pride and satisfaction in whatever you have achieved.

Your dedication to work is set to shift to the top gear. Find yourself swamped by excess of workload in the forenoon. Things, however, will lighten as the afternoon progresses. Expect a fun-filled, exciting evening. Adventure romance movies will excite you today. You want to explore an amazing destination to enthrall your sweetheart. You are in a mood to go on a long drive with your beloved. Some wonderful country music at the background will definitely delight your partner, says Ganesha. You are feeling good about everything that’s happening with you. You face no health problems today and you are surrounded by positive vibes. You will be great at presentation skills. You will spend more time with family and stay enthusiastic. Today, your enthusiasm to earn more money would be so high that you will not mind taking risks. Ganesha feels that this is going to be a good day for money matters, provided your decisions have logical grounds. It’s time to take the right step and not to allow the mistakes again, warns Ganesha. Confusion will never build commitment, says Ganesha. Today is the right day to solve all your difficulties. This will have a positive effect on your career.

Opportunities are rare, and good opportunities rarer still. Today, you will run to grab an opportunity and will make the most of it, says Ganesha. This move will yield instant results, and place you better in comparison with your opponents. Rivals, in fact, will try to do you down but will fail miserably in their attempt. Your social standing, on the other hand, will grow manifold and all because of your extraordinary traits. Safety rather than satisfaction is the top priority in a relationship, foresees Ganesha. You are likely to stay attached to your partner and in a mood to fulfill his/her needs. You love to do anything to please him/her. Bring confidence to build a long-term relationship. You need to take good care of yourself today. You should not ignore any sign that indicates weak health. You should also avoid getting tired. You should not take up activities that can make you feel worked up and take help from others. Joint assets and joint finances could create misunderstanding between you and your partner/friend or family member. Ganesha suggests you to remain alert in case of financial matters. An important call in the career front is waiting for you. It may be a new assignment, new meeting or a new goal. You need to be thoroughly prepared. You strive to be a bit more disciplined today. However, this needs to be done rather diplomatically.

You roar with absolute bliss today! Simplicity is your new avatar, and naturally, friends and acquaintances are mystified. You may wish to commune with the higher spirit and will seek solace in a quiet temple. Ganesha approves and predicts peace in plenty. Today, you are in a mood to simply relax and will let your beloved call the shots, which will make him/her feel special. You want to experiment the feeling of your soulmate and may want to present a special gift in return. So stay amazed and have a wonderful time. Don’t let stress make you feel tired and worked-up today. Do something for relaxation. Watch out on problems and try to keep them away. However, in this process you should not take stress as well. Stress will affect your health negatively. You must avoid investment in realty market and should wait for better planetary transits for the same. Your financial calculations will not be cent percent right so please proceed with caution. Avoid getting into negotiations inside or outside work. During negotiations, you may have to compromise on some counts. Try to avoid confusion so that it doesn’t create disagreement. Be very careful of the terms and conditions and then decide the matter, suggests Ganesha.

Staying afloat needs about as much effort as swimming. Cryptic as this may sound, what it means is you need to constantly reinvent yourself if you wish to keep going. You will shine in your profession only if it is also your passion, says Ganesha. Ganesha strongly suggests that you should give enough time to your personal life and make sure it’s not side-tracked because of work. Your partner may help you manage stress exceptionally well. He or she has some brilliant things. You just need to discover it. You are vulnerable today as you will need to remain on the toe to finish off your work and that may affect your health. However, maintaining extremely high level of patience could prevent the situation for you. That’s the way to remain in good health. Good part of the day is, today you will not be lending money to anyone without thinking nor you will be buying things on credit. You should be able to maintain fine balance between income and expenses. Today is a long day for you. You may have to stretch for longer hours in order to finish your work. You may feel bored and are in a mood to do some exciting tasks. However, you will be provided with the pending tasks to take some smarter decisions.
